title: Sales Manager (Real Estate)
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Sales Manager to lead our Real Estate Sales team. The ideal candidate will have 2 \-8 years of experience in the real estate market and a proven track record of success in real estate sales. The Sales Manager will be responsible for managing and developing a team of sales professionals, selling \& buying properties in Goa and near by states , driving revenue growth, and building strong customer relationships. If you are a results\-driven individual with excellent leadership and communication skills, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunities.

Role \& responsibilities

Drive sales for luxury real estate properties, achieving and exceeding sales targets.

Identify and cultivate potential buyers through various channels, including networking, referrals, and digital marketing.

Negotiate sales agreements and contracts, ensuring favorable terms for both clients and the company.

Generate Walk\-Ins through Channel Partners.

Attend to new clients and ensure maximum revisits.

Ensure proper follow\-up for leads and walk\-ins to achieve quick closures.

Activate channel partners for marketing and lead generation activities.

Participate in and organize regular promotional events.

Achieve monthly sales targets.

\*About Company\*  
GHD Infra Developers operates the business with the expertise of its management, with an aim to achieve the best quality and operational cost efficiency. The Company has built diverse modern civil, and structural engineering masterpieces and is engaged in designing, developing, and marketing real estate.

The company is managed \& guided by well\-qualified professionals who through the daily management processes, their expertise and experience ensure high standards in quality construction and customer satisfaction.

As one of the leading developers in India, the companys main focus remains on delivering the highest levels of world\-class Standards. Our projects include high\-rise apartments, villas, row houses, luxury apartments, luxurious resorts, and plotted land developments.

Committed and experienced workforce to ensure effective performance and operational efficiency.

Acknowledged for quality, commitment, integrity, and value addition.

Driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction, and magnificent blend of core values, work ethics, and service principles.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹85,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in Real Estate Sales?

Language:

* English, Hindi (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: BDE (Business Development Executive)
description:
Business Development Executive (BDE)Job Overview

We are looking for a proactive and target\-oriented **Business Development Executive (BDE)** to generate new business opportunities, build strong client relationships, and contribute to the company's sales growth. The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, experience in lead generation, and a good understanding of IT services and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

* Identify and generate **new business opportunities and qualified leads**.
* Conduct market research to identify potential clients, industries, and decision\-makers.
* Generate leads through **LinkedIn, email campaigns, cold calling, Upwork, referrals, and other channels**.
* Research prospects and understand their business requirements.
* Connect with potential clients through calls, emails, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, and online meetings.
* Understand client requirements and coordinate with technical teams to propose suitable solutions.
* Prepare customized **proposals, quotations, presentations, and pitches**.
* Manage regular follow\-ups and move prospects through the sales pipeline.
* Negotiate pricing, scope, timelines, and commercial terms with clients.
* Maintain accurate lead, prospect, and opportunity records in the CRM.
* Build and maintain long\-term relationships with existing and potential clients.
* Identify opportunities for **upselling, cross\-selling, and repeat business**.
* Track sales activities, conversions, and pipeline performance.
* Prepare regular sales reports and provide updates to management.
* Stay updated on market trends, competitor activities, and industry opportunities.

Required Skills

* Excellent **verbal and written English communication** skills.
* Strong lead\-generation and prospecting skills.
* Good understanding of **B2B sales and IT services**.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and client\-handling skills.
* Good follow\-up and relationship\-management abilities.
* Ability to understand basic technical requirements and communicate them effectively.
* Experience with **CRM and sales management tools**.
* Strong organizational and time\-management skills.
* Self\-motivated and comfortable working with sales targets.

Good to Have

* Experience with **LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, Upwork, Clutch**, or similar platforms.
* Experience in selling **software development, SaaS, web/mobile applications, AI/ML, cloud, cybersecurity, or IT services**.
* Experience working with international clients, particularly the **US, UK, UAE, Australia, or Europe**.
* Knowledge of email marketing and outbound sales campaigns.
* Basic understanding of technologies such as **React, Node.js, APIs, AWS, AI, and databases**.
* Experience with CRM platforms such as **HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce**, or similar tools.

Experience

**1–10 years** of experience in Business Development, IT Sales, B2B Sales, Lead Generation, or a related field.

What We’re Looking For

A proactive and results\-focused professional who can **identify the right prospects, build client relationships, generate qualified opportunities, and coordinate effectively with technical teams to convert business opportunities into clients**.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 \- ₹100,000\.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* Business development: 1 year (Preferred)
* total work: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: E-Commerce Executive
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and proactive **E\-Commerce Executive** to manage and grow our online marketplace presence. The ideal candidate will have hands\-on experience in product listing, catalog management, and online sales operations across multiple e\-commerce platforms.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage product listings, updates, and content optimization on **Amazon, Flipkart**
* Create SEO\-optimized titles, bullet points, and product descriptions to improve visibility and sales.
* Coordinate with design and content teams for product images and marketing content.
* Monitor inventory levels, pricing, and product performance reports across all platforms.
* Handle daily order processing, shipment tracking, and return management.
* Analyze sales trends and suggest strategies to increase conversions and visibility.
* Ensure compliance with marketplace policies and company standards.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Minimum **1 year of experience** in e\-commerce product listing and catalog management.
* Strong knowledge of **Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub.**
* Basic understanding of **SEO for e\-commerce**.
* Proficiency in **MS Excel**, **Google Sheets**, and data handling.
* Excellent communication, time management, and problem\-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with product photography coordination and catalog creation.
* Familiarity with digital marketing and marketplace advertising (e.g., Amazon Ads, Flipkart Ads).

**Salary:** Based on experience and performance **Job Type:** On\-Site \| Full\-Time

description:

title: Nutrition Officer
description:
Job Title: Nutrition Officer/ Executive  

Function: Infant Nutrition  

Location: Uttar Pradesh, J\&K, Rajasthan

  

About the role


This is a field role focused on ethical engagement with Health Care Professionals (HCPs) to share scientific, evidence‑based information on infant nutrition and Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition portfolio. The role requires clear and compliant communication of product features, advantages and benefits, and their appropriate use—strictly within Nestlé’s Code of Ethics, company instructions, and the Indian Code. The role consistently upholds the principle that mother’s milk is best for babies.

  

Job Description (Key Responsibilities)  

* Ethically promote Nestlé’s Infant Nutrition products to HCPs by clearly communicating


product features, advantages, benefits and appropriate use, in line with company Code  

of Ethics and the Indian Code; reinforce that mother’s milk is best for babies.  

* Ensure recommendations for the Nestlé Nutrition product range remain within the


scope of the Indian Code; detail against homemade paps and bovine milk as  

appropriate.  

* Serve as a reliable source of information on infant nutrition and infant feeding practices


for HCPs.  

* Plan and execute high‑quality scientific detailing, CMEs/symposiums and other


scientific activities as per company guidelines.  

* Map and segment HCPs in the assigned territory; develop and execute an effective


coverage plan and call cycle.  

* Maintain accurate records of HCP interactions, feedback, and scientific events; provide


timely reports as per guidance.  

* Identify opportunities and potential within the territory and contribute inputs to drive


demand generation activities within compliance.  

* Collaborate with internal teams to ensure availability of compliant scientific materials


and support tools for field execution.  

Qualifications  

* Graduate with at least 1 year of experience in a field sales role in either a Nutrition


company or the pharmaceutical industry.  

* High level of integrity and honesty; hardworking, self‑motivated, and passionate about


enhancing quality of life and contributing to a healthier future.  

* Ability to work effectively in a team and build strong, sustainable relationships with


stakeholders.  

* High learning agility; trustworthy and able to work independently within company


policies and guidelines.  

About Us  

At Nestlé, our purpose is to shape a better and healthier world, inspire people to live  

healthier lives, and deliver impact at a scale that truly makes a difference.  

We believe in a diverse, supportive and collaborative culture one that encourages  

innovation, embraces new ideas, and empowers individuals and teams to win. We’re driven  

by people who are friendly, respectful and inspiring people who genuinely care about the  

lives we touch every single day.

  

Diversity \& Inclusion  

At Nestlé, we are committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels  

respected, valued, and empowered to contribute. We celebrate diversity in all its forms  

gender, culture, abilities, backgrounds and perspectives because we believe it makes us  

stronger. We are dedicated to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment  

where people can bring their authentic selves to work and thrive.

  

Learn more:
